persona.name: Margaux Lefort

occupation.title: Freelance Graphic Designer
occupation.organization: Her own one-woman studio, working from a coworking space near the Ile de Nantes
occupation.description: Designs brand identities and packaging for regional food producers and cultural festivals. Feast-or-famine workload — some weeks are invoice-chasing, others are 60 hours of deadline. Her partner works in insurance with rigid hours, so dinner logistics land unevenly on whoever is least underwater.

persona.education: Ecole de design Nantes Atlantique; a year in Brussels at a branding agency that taught her what she didn't want.
long_term_goals: Keep the studio independent without taking a salaried job
Buy the small house in Bouguenais they keep visiting online
Do one gallery-worthy personal project a year
Get their weeknights back from screens and takeaway
persona.style: Dry, precise, and allergic to marketing language — she designs it for a living, so she dismantles it on sight. Speaks in complete, considered sentences and asks the question the salesperson hoped nobody would. Wears architect black with one loud accessory and drinks her coffee black. Compliments from her are rare and therefore currency.

traits: Independent to the point of stubbornness

likes: Knowing which farm her chicken came from
Brands that say less and mean it
Loyalty to the same fromager for a decade
dislikes: Being told a service will 'change her life'

beliefs: If the branding is louder than the product, run
Cooking from a market is a cultural act, not a chore
Freelance freedom is worth the income anxiety, most months

general: Shops at Talensac on Saturday and Biocoop midweek
Cooks properly maybe three nights a week, toast-level the rest
Reads terms and conditions out loud in a sarcastic voice
Photographs badly designed packaging as ammunition

morning: 7h50 up, black coffee, checks invoices before email
Cycles 15 minutes to the coworking space
workday: Client calls before noon, design work after
Lunch from the good boulangerie or leftovers in the shared kitchen
evening: Home by 19h30 on good days, 22h on deadline days
Dinner quality inversely proportional to the week's deadlines
weekend: Saturday: market, then cooking the one ambitious dish of the week
Sunday: cycling, drawing, dread-adjacent Monday planning

health.physical: Good baseline from cycling; wrist strain flares during heavy design periods.
health.mental: Income-cycle anxiety she manages with spreadsheets and long rides; otherwise sturdy.

relationships.name: Vincent
relationships.description: An insurance claims manager, kind and unadventurous; he'd sign up for a meal kit tomorrow and she suspects that's exactly what the marketing counts on.

relationships.name: Helene Lefort
relationships.description: A pediatrician in Angers with three kids who calls Margaux's food principles 'a luxury of the childless.'

relationships.name: Marc
relationships.description: A copywriter who trades her design critiques for his supplier gossip; they share a standing Friday lunch.
